locality_policy: City stores the provider locality, including towns. New York borough/locality variants are grouped under New York; Montréal and Newcastle upon Tyne use consistent spellings. UK venues use England under the existing United Kingdom country. Explicit corrections retain their primary sources.

review.note: The Premier League guide places the stadium in West Bridgford, south of Nottingham.
